cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(sample C)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 90)
add_executable(app src/net.c src/dir.c src/win.c)
if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
  target_sources(app PRIVATE src/osdep-linux.c)
elseif(APPLE)
  target_sources(app PRIVATE src/osdep-darwin.c)
elseif(WIN32)
  message(STATUS "windows")
else()
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Unsupported OS ${CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME}")
endif()
if(UNIX)
  target_link_libraries(app PRIVATE pthread dl)
endif()
if(WIN32)
  target_link_libraries(app PRIVATE ws2_32 rt)
endif()
